title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale. Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be. AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt. We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use. In this role, you'll... Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users. Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way. Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward. Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all. Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you. Key Details This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy. Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product. Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $142,200 - $203,300 USD, plus a generous equity package. Major benefits: Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country). 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance. Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. $10,000 annual charitable donation matching. Requirement 5+ years of experience in product management, or in a similar role where you owned products or processes end-to-end, ideally in high-ownership, fast-paced environments like scale-ups. Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and improving operational workflows that save teams time, produce accurate results, and run reliably at a reasonable cost. AI-fluent: you've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT to build skills, automations, or workflows that did something meaningful in your actual job, not just experiments. Speak fluent English Bonus if you Speak at least conversational French Have worked with Slack and an enterprise workflow tool like Monday, Jira or Linear. Have worked in or closely with large operations teams (support, field, finance) Are a mobile money user in Sub-Saharan Africa You might be a good fit if you Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way. Are a strong communicator that can inspire and lead by influence. Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures. Have a good nose for user-focused product design and obsess over user experience. Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable. Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle. Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives. Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact. Are excited about travel and meet users where they are — your users will be in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and other countries in Africa, and some travel will be essential. About Product at Wave Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago. Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave! If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here. If that's you, we'd love to meet you. Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most. We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue . How to apply Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role. We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals. Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Consultant (Enterprise Modernisation Architect)
description: <div class="description content"> <p>The Solution architect for Enterprise Modernization in Europe is a senior subject matter expert responsible for technical excellence, solution integrity, and capability development within the service line.</p> <p>This hands-on role leads high-impact client engagements, contributes to pre-sales and solution design, and ensures the regional adoption and evolution of service-specific delivery frameworks, tools, and best practices. The role brings deep expertise in modernization strategies and execution in large legacy systems modernization programs, serving as a trusted technical advisor to both clients and internal teams. This role is key to ensuring delivery quality, enabling service adoption, and evolving the technical maturity of the offering.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li>Provides technical guidance on Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Supports delivery teams in solving complex client problems.</li> <li>Contributes to solution design, proposals, and pre-sales activities.</li> <li>Develops and refines service accelerators and reference architectures.</li> <li>Mentors engineers and architects within the service domain.</li> <li>Acts as a bridge between delivery teams and global service development.</li> <li>Measures success by technical quality, asset adoption, and talent uplift.</li> <li>Requires 10+ years of experience in software engineering or technical consulting.</li> <li>Requires 3+ years in Enterprise Systems Modernization advisory.</li> <li>Focuses on technical depth in modernization strategies and enterprise solution architecture.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <br> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Experience supporting solution design and technical delivery in complex enterprise environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to build, extend, and support delivery tools, frameworks, and reusable assets.</li> <li>Deep technical expertise in modernization strategies, cloud architecture, and platform thinking.</li> <li>Strong engineering skills, architecture patterns knowledge, and toolchain understanding.</li> <li>Excellent communication to translate technical insights into actionable business decisions.</li> <li>Collaborative with mentorship abilities and solution-oriented with asset contribution commitment.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3>           <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>10+ years in software engineering, platform delivery, or technical consulting roles.</li> <li>3+ years in a subject matter expert or senior technical advisory role within Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.</li> <li>Certifications in relevant platforms, tools, or frameworks for the Enterprise Systems Modernization domain.</li> <li>Experience contributing to internal accelerators, open-source projects, or client-aligned IP development.</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise transformation programs and the consulting delivery lifecycle.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff System Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Build the test strategy that protects Graphcore’s system software releases at scale.</p> <p>As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape integration and system testing across firmware, BMC and Linux device drivers. Your work will help create a high quality gate for system software release packages.</p> <p>You will design, build, automate and report tests across complex server class systems. You will also develop reusable tools, pipelines and packaging solutions that help teams move faster with confidence.</p> <p>This role needs deep low level software knowledge and strong system thinking. You will own hard technical areas, guide best practice and stay close to the code.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>You will join a new integration and system test team within System Software QA. The team verifies integrated components across BMC, firmware and Linux device drivers.</p> <p>Work happens close to the hardware, across component teams and QA. You will partner with developers, consult package stakeholders and turn use cases into robust system tests.</p> <p>Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership.</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p>· Strong experience in low level system testing and integration across complex software and hardware layers.<br>· Deep understanding of RTOS, complex boot logic, Linux and device drivers.<br>· Test development capability using Python and C/C++.<br>· Experience working with hardware, debuggers, CI/CD pipelines and build or integration tools.<br>· Ability to debug cross-layer issues and drive root-cause investigations to lasting corrective actions.<br>· Clear communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and document complex technical decisions.</p> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.<br><br></p> <h2><strong>Job Summary</strong> </h2> <p>We are looking for a Principal Architect to define and drive the architectural vision of the software stack for the Graphcore ML accelerator.</p> <p>In this role, you will shape the architecture of our software ecosystem and maintain a deep understanding of the product’s hardware and software components, their interfaces, and how they interact.</p> <p>You are an excellent communicator, and you proactively convey the software architecture.</p> <p>You bring a pragmatic, trade-off-aware approach to decision-making, fully recognising the impact of architectural choices on product direction and engineering outcomes. </p> <h2><strong>The Team</strong> </h2> <p>The software architecture team is responsible for defining, maintaining and communicating the overarching architecture of our software stack, from firmware to ML frameworks.</p> <p>The team works within the wider software organisation, partnering closely with engineering teams who deliver against this architectural vision. </p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define & document the software architecture of the software stack.  </li> <li>Work across different software domains to ensure a coherent end too end architecture.</li> <li>Clearly communicate the software architecture to engineering teams.</li> <li>Ensure teams understand key software architectural components, interfaces, and guiding principles. </li> <li>Continuously maintain the software architecture as the product evolves. Communicate architectural changes proactively to all relevant stakeholders. </li> <li>Stay informed about trends and developments in the ML/software ecosystem.</li> <li>Assess the architectural impact of new technologies.</li> <li>Be aware of the usability, performance, reliability, maintainability, testability, security and observability constraints on the software architecture. </li> <li>Prototyping and validating architectural concepts through proof-of-concept implementations. </li> <li>Contribute to future and/or related product definitions with a forward-looking mindset, understanding and communicating the impact of future direction on software architecture. </li> <li>Work with the HW and Silicon architects to ensure product the needs of software stack. </li> <li>Ensure the software architecture meets the product requirements.  </li> <li>Work closely with engineering, product, leadership, and partners to ensure alignment between business goals and architectural direction. </li> </ul> <h2><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Essential:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Expertise in one or more of these technologies; Firmware, Drivers, ML frameworks (PyTorch, Triton, etc), Collectives, HPC, Tooling, C & C++, CPU architectures.</li> <li>Technical expertise in the ML accelerator software space.</li> <li>Excellent communication skill, both written and verbal. </li> <li>Collaborative mindset and ability to influence. </li> <li>Pragmatic approach to decision making, being very aware of trade-offs and implications. </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Demonstrable experience in a previous architecture role. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p><em>Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications</em></p> </li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Product Engineer
description: <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="135" data-end="148"><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p data-start="150" data-end="247">Turn complex manufacturing data into higher yield, stronger quality and better products at scale.</p> <p data-start="249" data-end="481">As Principal Product Engineer, you will help Graphcore manufacture advanced products with optimised yield, quality and cost. You will guide product performance through launch, production ramp and sustained high volume manufacturing.</p> <p data-start="483" data-end="663">Your work will influence chip manufacturing, test, PCBA and system level production. You will help teams find the signals that improve reliability, reduce cost and protect quality.</p> <p data-start="665" data-end="875">You will partner with OSATs, test engineering, manufacturing, quality, data engineering and analytics teams. Together, you will release new products and solve difficult yield, test and manufacturing challenges.</p> <p data-start="877" data-end="1058">This role suits someone who enjoys deep technical ownership and practical impact. You will turn manufacturing data into action across silicon, boards, blades and rack scale systems.</p> <p data-start="1060" data-end="1080"><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p data-start="1082" data-end="1276">You will join the Product Test and Diagnosis team within Manufacturing Operations. The team spans Bristol, Cambridge, India, the US and Taiwan, working close to products and production partners.</p> <p data-start="1278" data-end="1462">Work happens through direct ownership, technical depth and clear decisions. You will define best practice, challenge assumptions and move quickly when yield or quality needs attention.</p> <p data-start="1464" data-end="1653">The team connects silicon, board level assemblies, server blades and rack scale systems. Decisions are grounded in data, engineering judgement and accountability for manufacturing outcomes.</p> <p data-start="1655" data-end="1677"><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <p data-start="1679" data-end="2328">· Strong semiconductor product engineering, test engineering or manufacturing engineering capability in high volume production<br>· Deep understanding of semiconductor, PCBA and system level manufacturing and testing<br>· Strong statistical analysis skills, including SPC, DOE, regression, hypothesis testing and six sigma methods<br>· Proven ability to analyse and visualise large manufacturing datasets using Python, SQL, JMP or similar tools<br>· Experience driving yield, quality or cost improvements across complex manufacturing processes<br>· Ability to work across test, manufacturing, quality, data and external partner teams with clear technical ownership</p> <p data-start="2330" data-end="2578">While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p data-start="2580" data-end="2588"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-start="2590" data-end="3378">· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p data-start="3380" data-end="3742">We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p data-start="3744" data-end="3755"><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p data-start="3757" data-end="3913">Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p data-start="3915" data-end="3941"><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p data-start="3943" data-end="4222">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p data-start="4224" data-end="4506">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p data-start="4508" data-end="4830">Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p data-start="4832" data-end="4990" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">If you want to turn manufacturing insight into better products at scale, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to help shape product engineering at Graphcore.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Post-Silicon Validation
description: <p>Graphcore is a globally recognized leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and datacentre hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, we are working to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure that its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>We are developing the next generation of AI compute, a large-scale system-on-chip (SoC) designed to power future high-performance AI systems. As the Director of Post Silicon Validation, you will be responsible for leading the Bristol team, enabling pre-production software to run reliably on new silicon quickly and efficiently, before showing that the silicon meets the highest standards of quality, reliability and functionality, ready for production deployment.</p> <p>Reporting to the Senior Director of Post Silicon Validation, you will manage, develop and grow the Post Silicon Validation team in Bristol, delivering post-silicon validation across the full AI SoC, working across silicon, firmware, and platform levels. The role requires a deep technical understanding, strong hands-on debug experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Manage, develop and grow the Post Silicon Validation team in Bristol: </strong>The Post Silicon Validation team is relatively new, with a strong remit and growing quickly to help Graphcore bring up new silicon quickly and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Play a significant role in the definition, planning and execution of chip bringup activities: </strong>Develop and refine the overall post-silicon validation approach for our AI SoCs, ensuring reliable and timely delivery of validated silicon, architectural correctness, feature robustness, and at-scale system reliability.</li> <li><strong>Drive cross-domain debug and issue resolution: </strong>Lead investigation and resolution of complex issues spanning silicon, firmware, operating systems, and platform interactions. Ensure that fixes are effective and sustainable.</li> <li><strong>Promote collaboration and shared understanding: </strong>Work closely with design, software, and validation teams to align on quality objectives and debug priorities. Use data-driven insights and clear communication to maintain focus and alignment across teams.</li> <li><strong>Advance automation and scalable validation: </strong>Encourage the use of emulation, prototyping, and large-scale validation infrastructure to improve coverage and reduce time to debug.</li> <li><strong>Support continuous improvement: </strong>Foster a culture that values learning, transparency, and improvement in validation methods, automation, and analysis.</li> <li><strong>Engage with leadership and partners: </strong>Provide clear and concise updates on validation progress, risks, and quality indicators to executive teams and key partners. Contribute to product readiness assessments and roadmap decisions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Building and running high performing teams</li> <li>A systems thinker, comfortable working across hardware, software, and integration boundaries</li> <li>A collaborative leader who builds trust and alignment across diverse teams</li> <li>Skilled in technical problem solving and debugging complex post-silicon issues</li> <li>A clear communicator who can simplify complexity and support sound decision-making in fast-paced environments</li> <li>Committed to developing people and promoting an inclusive, high-performing team culture</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Electronic Engineering or equivalent; Master’s preferred</li> <li>20+ years in silicon, system, or platform validation, including 10+ years in technical leadership</li> <li>Proven experience leading post-silicon validation and bring-up for complex SoCs (AI, GPU, or CPU)</li> <li>Strong understanding of SoC architecture, coherency protocols, power management, and interconnects</li> <li>Expertise in debug tools, DFT infrastructure, and validation automation frameworks</li> <li>Proficient in C/C++, Python, and Linux-based environments; experience with large-scale validation clusters is an advantage</li> </ul> <p>Benefits</p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension, life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI Research Engineer
description: <h3><strong>About Graphcore</strong></h3> <p><span data-teams="true">At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence.</span></p> <h3>Job Summary</h3> <p class="p1">As a research engineer at Graphcore, you will contribute to the advancement of AI research, investigating new ideas that push the limits on important AI/ML problems. Specialised hardware has been the key driver of the progress of AI over the last decade, and we believe that hardware-aware AI algorithms and AI-aware hardware developments will continue to be critical to advancing this exciting field. We are therefore looking for individuals who combine strong machine learning experience with practical engineering skills to deliver impactful AI research. We are seeking AI researchers with strong software engineering experience, particularly in lower-level programming and performance optimisation for hardware efficiency. Our research spans a broad range of topics, including efficient training and inference, world models, life sciences, reinforcement learning, and beyond. You will work closely with researchers to generate ideas and translate them into scalable implementations, contributing to publications and projects that help to steer the future of AI hardware.</p> <p> </p> <h3>The Team</h3> <p>Graphcore Research participates in both fundamental and applied research, to characterise the computational requirements of machine intelligence and to demonstrate how hardware can drive the next generation of innovative AI models. We publish at leading AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) as well as specialist workshops, and collaborate with other research teams and organisations across the world.</p> <p>We pride ourselves on being a supportive and collaborative team, where we organise around our individual research interests to solve problems together in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications, including for sequence- and graph-based data. We’re based across London, Cambridge and Bristol, with projects and discussions that involve all our locations.</p> <p>Perhaps the best way to get an idea of what we’re all about is to read one of our <a href="https://graphcore-research.github.io/publications/">papers</a> or an article on our <a href="https://graphcore-research.github.io/posts/">blog</a>. If you’re excited to work at the cutting edge of AI supported by new hardware and want to develop your skills in this area, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <h3>Responsibilities and Duties</h3> <ul> <li>Generate AI/ML ideas, design experiments, implement them & evaluate results.</li> <li>Prepare, submit & present your work to AI conferences and workshops.</li> <li>Provide technical insight to internal teams by designing experiments and delivering clear, actionable reports.</li> <li>Collaborate with researchers, silicon and software engineers at Graphcore to help define, build and test Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>About you:</h3> <p>Essential:</p> <ul> <li> Master’s, PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline (e.g., Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry).</li> <li>Python programming in a modern deep learning framework, e.g. PyTorch or JAX.</li> <li>Familiar with deep learning fundamentals: models, optimisation, evaluation and scaling.</li> <li>Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments.</li> <li>Lower-level programming for hardware efficiency, e.g. C++/CUDA/Triton.</li> <li>Practical familiarity with hardware capabilities for deep learning – threads, caches, vector & matrix engines, data dependencies, bus widths and throttling.</li> <li>Practical familiarity with software stacks for deep learning – compilation, kernel fusion, XLA/ATen ops, streams, and asynchronous execution</li> </ul> <p>Desirable:</p> <ul> <li class="p1">Mathematics skills to support the above: calculus, probability theory and linear algebra.</li> <li class="p1">Experience submitting papers to international scientific conferences or workshops.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p> </p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications</em></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Security Engineer
description: Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work. Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual. Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate. A bit about us: 🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on. 🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision. 💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date. 🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster. 💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one. Role Overview 🔎 We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to own the security of Orbital's product: the AI agent our customers use, the platform it runs on, and how we build both. Our customers are law firms and real estate businesses. They trust us with confidential transaction documents, and they ask hard questions about how we protect them. Our product is an AI agent that reads those documents, calls tools and runs code on a lawyer's behalf. That brings the usual cloud security work and a newer set of risks: prompt injection, agents acting on untrusted input, and attackers using AI to move faster than before. You'll be our first in-house product security engineer, taking on work we have so far relied on contractors for. You'll build security into the product rather than review it from outside: you'll decide how we rate a vulnerability and how fast we act on it, build the automated systems that find and fix issues before an attacker does, and set the security bar that engineering builds to. You'll work alongside our product engineers, with the authority to require changes across teams on security grounds, independent of any one team's delivery deadlines. An information security lead will own company-wide policy, compliance and customer assurance, and you'll work closely with them. You won't start from zero. Our AWS environment follows the Well-Architected Framework, with GuardDuty, Security Hub, encryption at rest and scoped credentials in place, and we hold SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments to our customers. What we need is someone to own it, find the gaps, and raise the standard as the company and the threat landscape grow. You'll get a chance to 👩‍💻 👨‍💻 Build an automated security harness. Put agents to work on our product: continuous red-team and blue-team loops that probe the agent, the platform and our code, find vulnerabilities, and propose or ship the fix. Manual review should be justified when required and automatic harness improvement is expected. Own vulnerability management end to end. Define how we classify severity and the response time each level demands, so a critical CVE gets fixed the same day. Automate patching, dependency and image scanning, and make sure findings reach an owner and get closed. Secure an AI agent in production. Threat-model how our agent handles untrusted documents, emails and web content, and the tools and sandboxes it uses. Design defences against prompt injection and data exfiltration, and test them. Make security part of how we build. Review designs and changes that touch authentication, tenant isolation, secrets and data handling. Turn recurring findings into automated checks so the protection holds without depending on someone remembering. Respond to security incidents. Lead the technical response when something goes wrong: containment, investigation and the fix. Build the technical side of our breach playbooks with our information security lead, and run the review afterwards. Choose and run our security tooling. Evaluate and roll out a cloud security platform (such as Wiz) and the detection, alerting and logging we need across AWS and Azure. As our only product security specialist, use tooling and AI agents to cover more ground than one person could alone. Test our defences. Run red-team exercises, manage external penetration testers, and run breach drills with engineering so everyone knows their part before it matters. Close the loop on findings. Fix what penetration tests and security researchers report to us, run responsible disclosure, and keep the technical evidence for our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls current, working with our information security lead. Make the work visible. Show leadership and engineering what the harness finds, what has been fixed and what risk remains, in plain language, with a recommendation for each open risk. You should apply if you ✍️ You build with agents. You'd rather put an agent loop on a problem than repeat a manual review. You've used AI agents to find, triage or fix security issues, and you aim for automation that leaves people to review only the exceptions. You have deep, hands-on security engineering experience. You've owned security for a cloud-native product or platform and can do the work yourself, from reading code and IAM policies to configuring detection and running an investigation. You know AWS security well. IAM, network design, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail and how they fit together in a real production environment. You've led incident response. You've run a real security incident, including containment, investigation, communication and the follow-up, and you stay clear-headed under pressure. You take application and AI security seriously. You understand OWASP-class vulnerabilities, and you're interested in the new risks that come with LLM agents, such as prompt injection and over-broad tool access. You understand the product and the business. You know why a finding matters to our customers and our commercial position. You can tell a theoretical finding from one that puts customer data at risk, you spend effort where the risk is real, and you don't disappear down technical rabbit holes. You help teams ship safely. You find the secure way to do what the team needs, and you block work only when the risk justifies it. When you do, you explain why clearly enough that engineers understand and agree. You work independently. As our first in-house product security engineer, you'll set your own priorities, build the programme, and know when to bring in outside help. You bring people with you. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, a lawyer and a board member, adjusting the detail for each, and you change how teams work through influence rather than authority. You'll most likely come from a security engineering, product security or application security role at a fast-growing startup, or from a security consultancy with hands-on delivery. We're open to different backgrounds if you can show the depth, judgement and automation-first approach this role needs. It would also be nice if you have Experience securing LLM or agentic AI applications, or research into prompt injection and AI-specific threats. Harness engineering experience: building the tooling, evaluation loops and guardrails that let AI agents do real engineering work. Hands-on experience with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits. Experience with Azure, Kubernetes or container security, or sandboxed code execution. Familiarity with identity and SSO providers such as WorkOS or Okta. Experience in legal, financial or other regulated industries. 🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on. 💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you. 💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting . Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements. Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing Lead
description: Own marketing at an AI legal research company that already has 1,900+ firms as customers. Nylon is an AI-native tax and legal research platform used by 1,900+ accountancy and law firms across the UK, Australia and New Zealand. We were the first product accredited by ICAEW in the Legal Information and Research Software category, and we hold an ACCA affiliation. The UK business has been built almost entirely on outbound sales. It works, and it has taken us a long way. Now we want a second engine, and you would be the person who builds it. This is our first dedicated marketing hire in the UK. There is no team beneath you yet and no playbook to inherit. There is a working sales motion, a product accountants and lawyers actually use, strong accreditation credentials, and a founder-led company that moves quickly. You will set the marketing strategy and then do most of the work yourself. What you'll own Pipeline. SEO and content, paid search and LinkedIn, email nurture, webinars and free-trial campaigns. Your number is qualified pipeline handed to our SDR and AE team, and you will be measured on it. Brand and content. Sharpen how Nylon shows up in the UK accountancy and legal market: website, thought leadership, case studies, PR and awards, and the marketing side of our ICAEW and ACCA relationships. Product marketing. Own the messaging. Turn what the product does into language that lands with a tax partner or a managing partner, keep our positioning against incumbent research providers sharp, and equip the sales team with battlecards, decks and one-pagers. Events and community. Get us in front of the right people: ICAEW and ACCA events, industry conferences, our own roundtables and customer community. Some travel within the UK. Measurement. Set up attribution and reporting in our CRM (Attio) so we know what is working, and kill what is not. What we're looking for 5–8 years in B2B marketing, with at least a few of those in SaaS or a subscription product, ideally selling to professional services (accountancy, legal, financial services). You have built something from little or nothing before: a demand-gen function, a content programme, a launch. You are comfortable being the strategist and the person executing at 4pm on a Thursday. Fluent in the tools: SEO and analytics, paid search and paid social, marketing automation and CRM, and the AI tools that make a small team punch above its weight. You write well. Clearly, quickly, without fluff. Most of what marketing produces is words, and ours need to be credible to accountants and lawyers. Commercially minded. You care about pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics, and you enjoy working shoulder to shoulder with a sales team. Curious about AI and about how professional services firms are changing. You do not need a legal or tax background, but you need to be able to learn the market fast. Nice to have: experience marketing to accountants or lawyers; familiarity with ICAEW, ACCA or Law Society ecosystems; hands-on experience with webinar programmes or partnership marketing. What we offer £55,000–£70,000 base, depending on experience Real ownership: you set the strategy, you get the budget, you build the team as we grow A product customers rely on daily and a market that is being reshaped by AI right now A small, fast, international team across the UK, Australia and New Zealand Please send a CV and, instead of a cover letter, one page on how you would generate qualified pipeline for Nylon in your first 90 days. Nylon is the trading name of Law Cyborg Limited. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from everyone. You must have the right to work in the UK. title: Graduate Sales Development Representative (Life Sciences)
description: Graduate Sales Development Representative (Life Sciences) ➡️ Have a degree in Life Sciences and looking for an alternative to the lab where you can still use your scientific knowledge every day? ➡️ Excited by the opportunity to work with leading pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device companies, helping them accelerate innovation through AI? ➡️ Want to build a rewarding career in tech sales with exceptional training, uncapped commission and a clear path to becoming an Account Executive? If you're motivated by personal growth, enjoy speaking with people and want to build a career with exceptional earning potential, this could be the perfect opportunity. Our user-friendly platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle — using industry-leading, domain-specific AI to generate and validate ideas and bring innovative products to market faster, better, and cheaper. By connecting patents, scientific literature, clinical trials, regulatory data, and market intelligence, we enable our customers to identify white spaces, reduce R&D risk, and accelerate breakthrough innovation. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom. This is a true business development role where you'll learn how to identify opportunities, build relationships and create commercial value. Sales isn't about having all the answers, it's about asking great questions. Your scientific curiosity will help you understand customer challenges, while we'll teach you the commercial skills to build a successful career in SaaS sales. You will: Develop a hunter mindset, proactively identifying and engaging new prospects through phone, email and LinkedIn. Use your scientific background to build credibility with senior R&D, innovation and scientific leaders. Create and qualify new sales opportunities, turning cold prospects into valuable commercial conversations. We're looking for someone who: Has a degree (or equivalent experience) in Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline. Is excited by the idea of applying your scientific knowledge in a commercial, customer-facing role. Ambitious and motivated by success, with the drive to excel in an uncapped commission environment. Confident and proactive, comfortable starting conversations and building relationships with new people. Resilient and determined, with the mindset to overcome challenges and thrive in a target-driven environment. Naturally competitive, with a strong desire to achieve goals and progress quickly in your career. An excellent communicator, able to explain complex scientific concepts in a simple, engaging way. Curious, coachable and eager to learn, always looking for ways to improve. Organised and self-motivated, with the ability to manage your time and priorities effectively. Passionate about technology, AI and innovation, and excited by the impact they have on R&D and scientific discovery. A natural problem solver who enjoys understanding customers' challenges and helping them find solutions. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two days are the same. Benefits & Perks: A genuinely strong sales culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, social, and dynamic. and help modernise the existing Java codebase while contributing to new service development in Java and potentially Kotlin.</li> <li>Contribute to the architecture for order processing, market data RDBMS, including financial-grade data modelling.</li> <li>Solid grasp of software design principles (SOLID, DRY) and testing methodologies (unit, integration, end-to-end).</li> <li>Familiarity with CFTC compliance requirements, MNPI handling, and audit trail obligations in a regulated trading environment.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for backend services.</li> <li>Production reliability experience: monitoring, logging, alerting, on-call, and SLO definition.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to ship production code; able to articulate specific workflow improvements.</li> <li>Communicates complex technical concepts clearly to engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders.</li> <li>Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities evolve and decisions are made quickly.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Previous experience at a US-regulated financial exchange or licensed trading platform (e.g. CBOE, CME, or similar).</li> <li>Familiarity with low-latency trading systems, order book design, or market data infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience with low-latency in-memory systems and the performance engineering techniques required to operate them at scale.</li> <li>Experience with Aeron or similar high-performance messaging frameworks used in financial trading environments.</li> <li>Experience modernising legacy Java codebases in a financial services context.</li> <li>Previous experience in a high-growth or scale-up environment.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source projects or the technical community.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding You'll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver full-stack web features. </li> <li><strong>Develop and deliver. </strong>Your team has the autonomy to make a meaningful impact across the entire product area, listen to customers' needs and deliver game-changing features to push the boundaries of what they can achieve. Your team is empowered to take ownership of the user experience to support our coaches and athletes.</li> <li><strong>Test new ideas</strong>. At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. In addition to working on concrete features, you'll have the opportunity to propose solutions to more ambiguous technical problems and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.</li> <li><strong>Mentor. </strong>You'll share your expertise and educate others on development best practices and trade-offs, setting an example in planning, designing and delivering complex projects. </li> </ul> <h2>Location</h2> <p>Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have  the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. We're also open to remote candidates in the UK.</p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experienced. </strong>You have either led or played a key role in developing large-scale applications.</li> <li><strong>A team player</strong>. You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and will help others on our Engineering team learn and develop their skills.</li> <li><strong>User-focused</strong>. You're excited to have your work used by real people to solve real problems.</li> <li><strong>Willing to learn. </strong>You have solid engineering skills but are always willing to dive into specific areas to gain the expertise needed to be successful in your role.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Tech stack knowledge. </strong>Our core stack is C#/Node, React, TypeScript, MongoDB/SQL/ElasticSearch and AWS, so experience with these is ideal.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Champion work-life harmony.</strong> We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.</li> <li><strong>Guarantee autonomy.</strong> We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.</li> <li><strong>Encourage career growth.</strong> We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</li> <li><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed.</strong> We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.</li> <li><strong>Support your wellbeing.</strong> Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. </p> <p>This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion. </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Strategic Account Manager
description: Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement. Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far. Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . The Role As Omnea's Account Manager, you own the relationship with our customers across their entire lifecycle, working with some of our largest and most strategic accounts. Your job is to make sure customers get real, measurable value from Omnea from day one, and to turn that value into renewals, expansion, and upsell. Omnea's product is sticky: it's a business transformation, not a point tool, so once a customer is live, expansion tends to follow. Your focus skews heavily toward that expansion motion, not just keeping accounts renewed. You'll build deep, long-term relationships with your champions and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders at every level, from procurement managers up to CFOs. You'll be the internal voice of the customer, working closely with both technical and commercial teams to keep Omnea customer-centric at its core. This is an early hire on the customer team, working directly with Abs , Ben , and Rebe to build the function from the ground up. There's no fixed playbook yet: you'll help write it. What You'll Do Own a revenue number: You'll carry an NRR quota covering both expansion and retention across your enterprise book. That means proactively identifying upsell opportunities, running commercial conversations at exec level, and owning the renewal process end-to-end. Build relationships that go all the way to the top: Your relationships will run from procurement managers to CFOs. You'll multi-thread across each account, building genuine trust across multiple stakeholders, and you'll be the person customers call when something goes wrong or when they're thinking about what's next. Build the playbook from scratch: There's no fully built playbook yet - you'll help shape it. You'll work alongside an exceptional implementation team, product experts, and leadership that have scaled world-class companies to define the commercial rhythms, norms, and processes to set the standard as the function grows. Shape what Omnea builds next: You're the closest person to what our customers will and won't pay for. You'll feed that signal directly to Product and Revenue leadership, surfacing what's blocking adoption, what's driving expansion, and where we should be investing. What's Different About This Role This isn't a traditional post-sale account management role. Omnea's product is a business transformation, not a point tool, so most of your quota comes from expansion, not just renewal. We're not looking for a narrow "Account Manager" background. We want people from GTM roles broadly or from customer-facing roles with heavy commercial/GTM crossover. There's no fully built playbook. You'll define the commercial rhythms and processes as you go, working directly with Abs, Ben, and Rebe. You'll be as close to the product roadmap as anyone outside Product itself: what you hear from customers directly shapes what gets built next. About You We don't expect you to know exactly how to do all of this when you join. We're looking for someone with the right attitude and skillset to take this on. TL;DR: you're commercially sharp, and you instinctively know how to navigate complex organisations. You might come from a GTM role (sales, customer success, partnerships) or a customer-facing role with heavy GTM crossover. What matters is that you've worked in real enterprise environments, managed senior stakeholders with high expectations, and have a track record of getting things done. 4-8 years of experience in a top-tier, fast-paced environment: a startup, scale-up, VC, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself If you've been in a commercial role, you've worked six-figure ARR+ accounts, navigated multi-stakeholder buying committees, and built genuine executive relationships You build rapport, influence people, and drive change, whether with a distinguished exec or a junior operator. You have the gravitas to engage senior leadership, ideally up to CFOs, Legal, or Procurement You're comfortable in ambiguity. You don't need a fully built playbook: you'll build it as you go and improve it as you learn. You're organised enough to manage a complex book of business without dropping anything, and confident enough to push back on customers when they're wrong You're ambitious, competitive, and care about doing excellent work, with a track record of high performance in whatever you've turned your hand to: sales, academia, sport, or something of your own. You take ownership seriously, and you'd rather work hard on something meaningful than coast on something safe At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here . We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here ! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow! title: Sr Product Manager - Virality, Referrals & KOL
description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together. The opportunity Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets. Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business. Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys. Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships. Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams. Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment. Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers. Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale. What you bring You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers. Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted. Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate. Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models. Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs. Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try. Nice to haves Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts. Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls. Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments. Payward acquires and integrates companies continuously, across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory regimes. Every target arrives with its own controls, its own maturity level and its own audit history, and every one enters our financial statement audit scope on a timeline set by the deal rather than by readiness. Today that work competes for the same people who run controls for the parent company. This role exists so that it has a dedicated owner. Gravitas and strong collaboration are essential.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Team direction and oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct a team of data, technology and business consultants, analysts and engineers, overseeing client briefs and managing team workload.</li> <li>Direct and motivate the team to help them achieve their goals and deliver brilliant work for VML’s clients.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data & Analytics leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as strategic partner and advisor, helping clients to leverage the power of data, martech, analytics and AI to achieve their goals and drive effectiveness and efficiency.</li> <li>Develop proposals and methodologies for <ul> <li>Data Planning; encompassing data-driven journey design, targeting personalisation, test and learn</li> <li>Analytics & Data Science solutions; encompassing customer analytics (e.g. customer segmentation, predictive modelling), digital analytics (e.g. journey analysis, web/app, media analysis), business intelligence (e.g. dashboard reporting) and AI (e.g. conversational BI)</li> <li>Data & Analytics consulting; encompassing data, marketing technology, AI and operations (process, skills, culture, business change etc.).
