thought-leadership and best practice.</li> <li>Work closely with our clients to help diagnose and solve their challenges, support their data & AI vision, and make it happen.</li> <li>Drive client success and satisfaction in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>New business – be a data and analytics lead for pitches to deliver winning proposals and presentations.</li> <li>New & Organic business – be relentless at bringing new ideas and opportunities to grow our existing clients and bring our data offer to clients who work with us in other disciplines.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What you’ll need:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional experience leading across data and analytics in a consulting/agency environment, setting up teams and operating models with clients</li> <li>A belief in the value of data-driven marketing & AI to deliver exceptional results.</li> <li>Experience of building relationships with clients from junior to C-suite and dealing with the different and complex personalities involved.</li> <li>Someone who can unify groups from across a wide skill set and unify them behind a clear brief or goal and deliver excellent work for clients.</li> <li>A candidate with the ability to engage people with their presentation skills but show excellent active listening to create clear actions which meet client needs.</li> <li>A person with a love for data-driven marketing and is constantly following trends to develop impactful and significant work for our clients.</li> <li>Significant experience at scoping, resourcing, and developing commercial proposals.</li> <li>Knowledge of data and analytics technologies across the marketing and digital ecosystem including media, commerce, social and digital platforms, CRM & loyalty</li> <li>Knowledge of analytics solutions and how AI can be leveraged in marketing to drive growth.</li> <li>Must have knowledge (you need not be a deep practitioner in all these areas, but do need have a good appreciation across them): <ul> <li>Data strategy consulting – data landscape (1<sup>st</sup>, 2<sup>nd</sup>, 3<sup>rd</sup> party data), data management, governance, roadmap and use case development</li> <li>Analytics & AI – segmentation, predictive modelling, measurement & reporting, AI marketing applications and product development</li> <li>Marketing technologies – data cloud solutions, clean rooms, analytics and reporting tools, CDPs, CRM / marketing automation, AI technologies</li> <li>Marketing operations – operating models, process design, governance, data culture and skills development, client enablement and business change</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>At VML, we are committed to fostering an all-inclusive work environment that is both rewarding and career-forward. Our Inclusion, Equity & Belonging initiatives, alongside the VML Foundation, reflect our dedication to giving back and making a positive impact in our communities and beyond. description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. The Role: Build the data, decisioning and automated systems that allow Paddle to take more good risk while reducing fraud losses, unnecessary customer friction and manual work. Paddle’s Merchant of Record model makes risk a critical part of the product and its economics. Seller quality, buyer fraud, payment acceptance, refunds, disputes, reserves and card-scheme exposure cannot be optimised independently. This role will connect those signals, identify where the largest value is being lost, turn risk priorities into working controls and workflows, prove their effect in production, and establish a durable owner once a capability becomes repeatable. This is not a strategy-only role and it is not ownership of a large operational team. It is a hands-on build role at the intersection of risk, data, product, engineering and operations. What you'll do: Work hands-on with SQL (Snowflake, dbt), Python, statistics and modern AI-assisted tools to explore data, test hypotheses, prototype controls and evaluate results. Map the end-to-end seller risk system, its data, decisions, controls, owners and failure points. Establish the baseline before building: fraud losses, alert yield, time-to-detect, exposure at detection and analyst effort, with losses reconciled with Finance. Own the health of live controls: every rule and check has an owner, an expected volume, a measured yield and alerting when it goes quiet or drifts, and every change is tested and impact-assessed before release. Build and maintain a labelled library of confirmed fraud cases and a shared fraud typology: the basis for rules now and for machine-learning models with Data Science later. Build a value-ranked portfolio of risk opportunities. Translate risk problems into clear product, data and engineering work with measurable acceptance criteria. Design seller risk tiers that set payout timing, reserves and limits, giving good sellers more room and tightening controls on riskier ones. Backtest rules and risk scores on point-in-time data, and design control experiments, shadow tests and phased roll-outs that measure both loss reduction and legitimate-customer impact. Produce decision artefacts that let senior leaders make trade-offs about risk appetite, engineering investment, customer experience and commercial growth. Stay with each major capability until it works in production, then establish its long-term owner and move to the next high-value problem. Expected 6 month outcomes: At least one major seller-risk journey has materially improved on agreed loss, approval, speed or manual-effort measures. Fraud/Risk Operations spends significantly less time on repetitive screening and more time on investigation, judgement and improvement. Stable capabilities have been handed to durable owners, leaving the role free to take on the next high-value problems. We'd love to hear from you if you: Significant experience building or improving merchant- or seller-side fraud detection at a PSP, acquirer, payfac, marketplace or Merchant of Record, and a working knowledge of how bust-out, transaction laundering and self-dealing show up in the data. Strong hands-on analytical ability, fluency in SQL (Snowflake, dbt or similar), Python and statistics, plus experience using LLMs on unstructured data such as website content or support tickets, with measured accuracy. Experience working with decision flow systems such as Tactile A record of turning ambiguous cross-functional problems into systems that were adopted and produced measurable results. Experience designing, backtesting and tuning rules and risk scores on point-in-time data, and evaluating them when labels are delayed, partial and adversarial. Able to put risk trade-offs in money (fraud losses, approval rates, customer friction, operating cost and revenue from seller categories declined today) using a method Finance will sign off. Good judgement about when a problem needs a rule, a workflow, an experiment, a vendor, a model or an agent—and when it needs none of them. Ability to work credibly with investigators, operators, product managers, engineers, data scientists and executives. Comfortable challenging inherited assumptions while keeping the people closest to the work involved. More interested in solving and shipping than in building an empire. title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services)
description: UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the role The Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services) will design, build, and operate the software services that run on UFORCE’s uncrewed vehicles — spanning video streaming, telemetry, autonomy integration, vehicle control, health monitoring, navigation, and device integrations. You will turn independently evolved services into one secure, testable, and maintainable onboard platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on production Python services, service architecture, messaging, and reliable operation on constrained Linux hardware, including Raspberry Pi, x86, and NVIDIA Jetson. You will also own the boundary between the vehicle and the backend: clear, versioned contracts with cloud services, deployment systems, video infrastructure, and operator interfaces that work over intermittent, low-bandwidth links. Working with backend, autonomy, hardware, QA, and field teams, you will make releases predictable and catch failures on the bench, not in the field. What you’ll do Define and evolve a unified onboard service architecture: service boundaries, messaging, configuration, startup ordering, readiness, watchdogs, and graceful degradation when dependencies or devices are unavailable. Build and migrate production services to shared patterns, using reusable libraries and a reference service template covering project structure, packaging, logging, health reporting, and lifecycle management. Standardise local service communication around NATS, with clear rules for integrating MAVLink, ZMQ IPC, and HTTP where appropriate. Design stable, versioned vehicle-to-backend contracts for telemetry, commands and acknowledgements, video metadata and control, configuration, health, and logs. Engineer for unreliable connectivity: buffering and store-and-forward, idempotent commands, explicit acknowledgements and timeouts, reconnection, back-off, and safe behaviour when the backend is unreachable. Implement secure-by-default services: least-privilege identities and messaging permissions, mutually authenticated and encrypted backend links, secure credential provisioning and rotation, sandboxed runtimes, and audit events for safety-critical commands. Strengthen automated testing across unit, contract, integration, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tests, with CI gates that catch regressions before release. Build safer release workflows with signed packages, dependency scanning, bench smoke and soak tests, staged fleet rollouts, and reliable rollback. Profile services and enforce practical CPU, memory, and latency budgets on target hardware. Improve field diagnostics through structured logs, metrics, standardised health reporting, post-mission log capture, and actionable runbooks. Document architectural decisions and service interfaces, communicate trade-offs clearly, and use AI coding tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality. What success looks like Actively developed onboard services converge on a shared architecture, supported Python runtime, messaging model, and service template. Engineers can take a new service from an empty repository to running on a bench vehicle in a day or less, with less duplicated infrastructure code. Vehicle-to-backend contracts remain compatible as cloud and vehicle software evolve at different speeds, preventing integration failures in the field. Authentication, least privilege, secret handling, runtime hardening, and supply-chain checks are consistently applied across the onboard stack. Automated tests and bench validation catch defects before deployment, reducing issues discovered in the field. Releases move predictably from bench validation to pilot vehicles and the wider fleet, with clear readiness gates and rollback procedures. Services stay within resource budgets and remain diagnosable under hardware constraints and degraded connectivity. Architecture documentation and runbooks help engineering, QA, and field teams integrate changes and resolve failures faster. Required Qualifications 7+ years of professional software engineering , delivering and operating production services. Strong Python — experience designing and shipping production services, including asyncio, packaging, testing, and profiling; Node.js experience is a plus. Web development and API experience — experience building and evolving HTTP/WebSocket APIs and message-based integrations with versioned contracts. Development with AI tools — uses AI coding assistants/agents daily and can demonstrate how they apply these tools to design, implementation, review, and testing while maintaining high quality. Security-first engineering — has applied authentication/authorisation, secrets management, least privilege, and secure update practices in a real system. Testing and release discipline — has built test suites and CI gates for unit, integration, and contract testing, and shipped software through staged releases with rollback. Experience with simulators or hardware-in-the-loop testing is a plus. C++, Rust, or Go experience is a plus. UxV, robotics, or embedded/edge Linux experience is a plus (e.g., MAVLink, GStreamer, serial/CAN devices, or systemd services on constrained hardware). The nature of combat has changed. Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability. And UFORCE is ready. Are You? Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

400;"> </span></h4> <ul> <li>Co-own the day-to-day operation, triage, and tuning of the Samsara endpoint security environment by responding to escalations, investigating anomalies, and resolving description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the <strong>FinTech</strong> connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers <strong>better interest rates</strong> and banks a <strong>diversified form of refinancing</strong>. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.</p> <p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from <strong>more than one million investors</strong> which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Team</strong></span></p> <p>Our Raisin UK Finance team is expanding, and we are looking for a hands-on, commercially astute <strong>Senior Finance Manager</strong> to join our Manchester office. Working directly alongside the Head of Finance UK, this is a high-impact individual contributor role designed for an autonomous operator who thrives on ownership, commercial variety, and cross-functional leadership. With a primary emphasis on FP&A and commercial growth, you will bridge strategic forecasting, business partnering, financial reporting, and process automation in a fast-growing fintech scale-up.</p> <p><br><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Financial Reporting, Controlling & Audit Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the preparation of timely, high-accuracy monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with UK GAAP/ IFRS, alongside insightful internal management reporting packages.</li> <li>Lead core operational accounting workflows, including revenue invoicing, reconciliations, and balance sheet integrity.</li> <li>Evaluate, establish, and continuously enhance internal financial controls, governance workflows, and accounting procedures.</li> <li>Serve as a key operational point of contact for internal and external auditors, ensuring smooth, efficient audit cycles and statutory compliance.</li> <li>Conduct ad-hoc financial evaluations and commercial business cases requested by local executive leadership and central Group Finance. </li> <li>Partner closely with Business Development (BD) and Relationship Managers (RMs) to model, anticipate, and stress-test future Assets on Platform (AoP) volumes, evaluate growth bottlenecks, and unlock new revenue expansion opportunities. </li> <li>Possess end-to-end knowledge of core accounting functions to provide seamless interim coverage and operational backfill across the finance team when needed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Planning, Forecasting & Commercial Analysis</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive regular financial forecasting cycles, variance analyses, and the annual budgeting process for the UK business.</li> <li>Deliver regular, actionable analyses of trading performance, unit economics, and underlying revenue trends to inform operational strategy.</li> <li>Conduct ad-hoc financial and commercial analyses requested by local leadership and central Group Finance stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Finance Business Partnering & System Architecture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted finance partner to commercial teams and operational leaders, guiding budget holders on spend optimization, ROI, and resource allocation.</li> <li>Champion financial process automation and AI adoption—leveraging modern workflow tools and AI-driven solutions to automate reporting, revenue recognition, invoicing, and billing cycles.</li> <li>Support the ongoing evolution of our controlling systems landscape and internal reporting architecture.</li> <li>Champion financial process automation—particularly around revenue recognition, invoicing, and billing workflows.</li> <li>Support local rollout and implementation of group-wide finance tools and enterprise systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Profile</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Relevant Experience:</strong> 4+ years of progressive experience in roles such as Financial Controller, Senior Management Accountant, or FP&A / Controlling, ideally within a scaling fintech, tech platform, or dynamic high-growth business. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.</p> <p>As part of our team, you will benefit from:</p> <ul> <li>Employee Development Budget of £1,700 and 4 full training days per year.</li> <li>Always hungry? title: Senior Financial Control Analyst, 9 Month Fixed Term Contract
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges! We are looking to introduce a Senior Financial Control Analyst on a 9 Month Fixed Term Contract. </p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial HM Interview </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TP1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health
location: United States, United Kingdom, Nigeria, Rwanda, Ethiopia, DRC, India
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL)</span></span><span data-contrast="none"> is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest </span><span data-contrast="none">health threats. </span><span data-contrast="none">Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><p><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  </span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p>The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.</p> <p>The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Work Location: </strong>100% Remote with travel as stated. </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <h4><strong>Strategic</strong> <strong>Leadership</strong> <strong>and Portfolio Management</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.</li> <li>Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.</li> <li>Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Technical Leadership and Program Development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.</li> <li>Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.</li> <li>Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.</li> <li>Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead senior-level engagement with Ministries of Health and national partners to identify priorities, shape country strategies and secure government ownership of programs and results.</li> <li>Develop and manage strategic partnerships with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Performance, Learning and Accountability</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.</li> <li>Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Education</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.</li> <li>Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills & Abilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.</li> <li>Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.</li> <li>Fluency in English required; proficiency in French desirable.</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30% during program start-up and up to 25% thereafter.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">The salary range </span><strong><span data-contrast="none">for applicants based in the US</span></strong><span data-contrast="none"> is $150,000 to $170,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. </span><strong><span data-contrast="none">For applicants based outside the US</span></strong><span data-contrast="none">, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector. </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including:</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="none">Health insurance for you and your dependents</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559685":450,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":75}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Contributions toward retirement </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559685":450,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":75}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559685":450,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":75}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559685":450,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":75}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Professional development and home office setup benefits</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":1677721

Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/UK Remote | £56,100 - £70,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +  <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐️ Our Costs Team </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Finance Analyst to take a leading role in managing operating expenses across Monzo's Collectives and Disciplines, helping business leaders understand financial performance, anticipate emerging risks and make better-informed spending decisions.</p> <p>This role takes independent ownership of an allocated cost portfolio, combining financial planning, forecasting, performance management and commercial analysis. You'll go beyond maintaining accurate financial models and reporting to challenge assumptions, investigate complex cost drivers and recommend actions that improve financial performance.</p> <p>You'll work directly with senior business stakeholders, Finance Business Partners, Procurement and the wider Cost Efficiency team. You'll also help raise the standard of financial analysis across the team, supporting less experienced analysts and improving how we forecast, report and manage costs.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Independently owning operating expense planning and forecasting for your allocated Collectives and Disciplines, building and maintaining robust financial models, challenging business assumptions and explaining material movements in the expected full-year position.</li> <li>Leading financial performance analysis for your portfolio, investigating complex variances across cost lines, suppliers and business activities, identifying underlying drivers and translating findings into quantified risks, opportunities and management recommendations.</li> <li>Driving monthly business performance discussions, producing and presenting decision-ready financial insight to senior stakeholders, confidently challenging expenditure, explaining forecast implications and securing agreement on actions.</li> <li>Providing financial analysis for material business decisions, evaluating new investments, supplier commitments, organisational changes and cost initiatives, including their affordability, in-year impact, annualised run-rate and expected financial benefits.</li> <li>Proactively identifying and delivering cost efficiency opportunities, partnering with Procurement and business owners to challenge existing expenditure, quantify achievable savings and track delivery against agreed financial baselines.</li> <li>Maintaining strong financial control and forecasting discipline, overseeing the quality of month-end actuals, accruals, forecast assumptions and financial commentary within your portfolio, resolving complex issues and escalating material risks early.</li> <li>Raising the capability of the wider analyst team, providing technical guidance, reviewing complex analysis, sharing financial modelling and reporting best practices, and helping less experienced colleagues develop their financial judgement.</li> <li>Leading targeted improvements to financial processes and reporting, identifying recurring weaknesses in forecasting, data quality or controls, and working with Finance Data and colleagues to implement measurable improvements in accuracy, efficiency and scalability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong hands-on experience in FP&A, commercial finance or management accounting, including independent ownership of financial forecasts, management reporting and financial performance analysis.</li> <li>You're highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, with experience building and maintaining driver-based financial models, scenario analysis and reconciliations that other Finance colleagues can confidently review and use.</li> <li>You can demonstrate experience challenging forecasts and identifying the underlying business drivers of financial performance, rather than relying solely on historical variance analysis.</li> <li>You've independently prepared and presented financial analysis to senior business stakeholders, explaining complex financial matters, challenging assumptions and influencing decisions.</li> <li>You have experience evaluating business cases, supplier commitments or cost initiatives, including quantifying financial impacts, assessing assumptions and tracking expected benefits.</li> <li>You can demonstrate improvements you've made to financial processes, forecasting models or reporting, with measurable benefits such as improved accuracy, reduced manual effort or stronger controls.</li> <li>You've helped develop the technical capability of colleagues, through coaching, peer review, sharing modelling techniques or improving the quality of financial analysis across a team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to performance. </p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office, with a hybrid working environment with flexible working from home arrangements and some in-person attendance. We're open to distributed working within the UK (with the expectation of occasional work from our London office for key meetings).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits<br><br></a></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has these 3 key steps:</strong></p> <ol> <li>Phone call with recruiter (30 minutes)</li> <li>Role Specific with Hiring Manager & Finance Business Partner (45 Minutes)</li> <li>Behavioural Interview with Head of Department & Senior Finance Manager (45 Minutes) </li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <strong><em><br><br></em></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

Mission. Action. Growth. Inclusion. Care.</p> <p>It's at the heart of everything we do. Within our People Collective, we're here to bring brilliant people together, build an inclusive culture and create an environment where everyone can do their best work. As Monzo continues to grow, our offices play an important role in bringing our people together. They're more than just places to work. They're spaces where teams connect, collaborate and experience what it means to be a Monzonaut.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced <strong>Property & Facilities Lead</strong> to join us on a 12 month fixed term contract, covering caregiver leave. You'll lead a team of six across four office locations in London, Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona, helping us deliver an exceptional workplace experience while managing and developing our global property portfolio.</p> <p>Reporting to the Head of Property, Culture and Engagement, you'll oversee our daily operations, lead strategic projects and collaborate with teams across Monzo to create safe, welcoming and engaging workplaces that bring people together and put the Monzonaut community first.</p> <h2><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by...</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>🏢 Leading our global property and facilities operations</strong> – Overseeing our office locations, ensuring they're safe and compliant, while delivering a consistent and delightful workplace experience.</li> <li><strong>🚀 Managing and delivering property projects</strong> – Leading projects from planning to delivery, including office moves, refurbishments and new site launches. You'll manage timelines, budgets and internal and external stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>🌍 Supporting our global property strategy</strong> – Turning our longer term property ambitions into practical plans, ensuring our spaces meet the needs of our people and support Monzo's continued growth.</li> <li><strong>💪 Leading and developing a brilliant team</strong> – Managing six team members across all locations, setting clear priorities, supporting their development and building a scalable, high-performing function.</li> <li><strong>🤝 Collaborating across Monzo</strong> – Building strong relationships with Finance, Legal, TechOps and senior leadership to align priorities, influence decisions and deliver improvements.</li> <li><strong>💰 Managing budgets and suppliers</strong> – Overseeing property and facilities budgets, managing supplier relationships and ensuring we're delivering value for money across our portfolio.</li> <li><strong>🦺 Keeping our spaces safe and sustainable</strong> – Ensuring our workplaces meet health and safety requirements, managing compliance and working with the ESG team to deliver our Scope 1 and 2 environmental commitments.</li> <li><strong>✨ Continuously improving how we work</strong> – Using data and employee feedback to improve our spaces, streamline processes and build scalable ways of working. You'll also be happy to roll up your sleeves and provide hands on support when needed.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>🤩 We'd love to hear from you if...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have strong <strong>property and facilities management experience</strong>, ideally in a fast-paced, growing organisation with multiple office locations.</li> <li>You're an <strong>experienced project manager</strong>, confident leading complex projects end to end, managing timelines, budgets, risks and competing priorities.</li> <li>You're a <strong>confident people leader</strong>, with experience managing, coaching and developing high performing teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>commercially minded</strong>, with experience managing budgets, suppliers and contracts while balancing cost, quality and employee experience.</li> <li>You're a <strong>strong communicator and collaborator</strong>, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and building relationships across teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>proactive, organised and adaptable</strong>, able to balance day-to-day operations with strategic priorities, navigate ambiguity and make decisions independently.</li> <li>You're <strong>data-driven</strong>, and can use insights to make decisions and improve processes.</li> <li>You have a good understanding of <strong>workplace health and safety</strong>, and are confident using digital tools such as Google Workspace and Slack</li> <li>[Nice to have] You have a formal health and safety, facilities and/or project  management qualification such as IWFM 7, NVQ, NEBOSH, PRINCE 2 or APM.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! </strong>We know that some people are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every requirement. At Monzo, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we care just as much about your potential as your experience. If you're excited about this opportunity and think you could make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <h2><strong>🙌 What's in it for you</strong></h2> <p>💰 £60k - £65k + Incentive Awards</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office, with a minimum of three days per week in the office. You'll also travel periodically to our Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona offices.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to manage your time in a way that works for you, your team and the role.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 annual learning budget to spend on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We'll provide you with a MacBook and the equipment you need to work effectively.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h2><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h2> <p>Our hiring process is designed to help us get to know you, your experience and how you approach real-world challenges.</p> <p>There are four stages:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial call</strong> – An initial conversation to learn more about you and share more about the opportunity.</li> <li><strong>Role-specific interview</strong> – A deeper conversation about your technical experience, project management and approach to leading a multi-site function.</li> <li><strong>Manager and leadership interview</strong> – An opportunity to explore your leadership style, stakeholder management and how you approach decision-making.</li> </ol> <p>We aim to complete the process in around 2–3 weeks and will be as flexible as possible to accommodate your schedule.</p> <p>We also have some guidance on using AI during your application and interview.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read it here.</a></p> <p>#LI-OH #LI-LONDON</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Account Executive, Growth (EMEA)
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. As an Account Executive at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product and help high-impact companies build better software. Location & work mode While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role is specifically based in London. We’re looking for someone who can work from our London office in Shoreditch 3 days per week (Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays), as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region. What you'll do - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly and annual targets - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team What we're looking for - 5+ years in a quota-carrying sales role - Experience selling to a technical audience; bonus if you have previous experience working with a collaboration or developer tool - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators What we offer We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect: - Competitive salary and equity - Employee-friendly equity terms - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday - Health coverage (based on country requirements) - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays - 4 months paid parental leave - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter - Regular team events and off-sites Learn how we think and work - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM - Make an Org Chart You Want to Ship — Advice from Linear on How Heirloom Tomatoes Should Inspire Team Design https://review.firstround.com/make-an-org-chart-you-want-to-ship-advice-from-linear-on-how-heirloom-tomatoes-should-inspire-team-design/ - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tax concepts to non-tax stakeholders.</li> <li><span style="font-weight: 300;">Business level written and spoken English</span> with excellent presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>Focus on results, with a personal drive to meet commitments.</li> style="font-weight: 300;">International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 300;">In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leadership ability</li> <li>Software or tech industry experience</li> <li>Public company finance and reporting experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 300;">We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Bi-annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Company recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Maternity and paternity leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 300;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London (UK)  | 💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Capital, Impairments & Forecasting Team ⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Capital, Impairments & Forecasting team (CIF) sits at the intersection of our Borrowing and Finance collectives, responsible for developing, executing and managing the models used to calculate IFRS 9 ECL, and credit risk capital through the annual ICAAP. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. You’ll craft an ambitious roadmap rooted in deep customer insight, emerging market dynamics, and commercial impact—setting a vision that differentiates Monzo in the business banking space.</p> <p>This role is a rare blend of strategic thinking, world-class product taste, analytical depth, and an ability to consistently ship great work. our business customers.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Product Strategy & Vision</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set a bold, customer-centric, commercially grounded product strategy for offerings.</li> <li>Drive teams to create unique, delightful products based on exceptional product taste.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Analytical & Strategic Depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spar with data scientists and use data to understand “the why” behind customer behaviour, product performance, and opportunities.</li> <li>Help teams deepen their analytical thinking, improving decision-making quality across the org.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Execution & High-Performance Culture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build an execution engine that consistently delivers against ambitious goals.</li> <li>Create extreme clarity on priorities, establish strong processes, remove blockers, and maintain team momentum.</li> <li>Instil a culture of ownership, speed, and high performance.</li> </ul> teams to thrive.</li> <li>Hire, coach, and develop exceptional product managers, helping them reach their full potential and cultivating the next generation of Monzo product leaders.</li> </ul> As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p><strong>Help build the future of customer operations</strong></p> <p>We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-SS2</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer.
